mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_credit_profile ( user_id, name, id_card, phone, email, birth_date, gender, education, occupation, family_info, financial_info, employment_info, age, debt_ratio, monthly_income, credit_lines, dependents, revolving_util, credit_score, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{name}, #{idCard}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{birthDate}, #{gender}, #{education}, #{occupation}, #{familyInfo}, #{financialInfo}, #{employmentInfo}, #{age}, #{debtRatio}, #{monthlyIncome}, #{creditLines}, #{dependents}, #{revolvingUtil}, #{creditScore}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE user_credit_profile SET name = #{name}, id_card = #{idCard}, phone = #{phone}, email = #{email}, birth_date = #{birthDate}, gender = #{gender}, education = #{education}, occupation = #{occupation}, family_info = #{familyInfo}, financial_info = #{financialInfo}, employment_info = #{employmentInfo}, age = #{age}, debt_ratio = #{debtRatio}, monthly_income = #{monthlyIncome}, credit_lines = #{creditLines}, dependents = #{dependents}, revolving_util = #{revolvingUtil}, update_time = #{updateTime} WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id AS userId, name, id_card AS idCard, phone, email, birth_date AS birthDate, gender, education, occupation, family_info AS familyInfo, financial_info AS financialInfo, employment_info AS employmentInfo, age, debt_ratio AS debtRatio, monthly_income AS monthlyIncome, credit_lines AS creditLines, dependents, revolving_util AS revolvingUtil, credit_score AS creditScore, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM user_credit_profile WHERE user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
